notes: The second *concerning* is read as a distributed repetition of the one עַל under rule 25 rather than as `added`; the competing reading marks it added.
The אֵת of s035 stands on the appositive itself, so it takes the ASV's *even* under rule 16's second family, while the two markers on bare objects are unrepresented.
*both … and* belongs whole to the one waw, headed on the closing connective, no other morpheme in the phrase claiming the opening word (rule 14).
